```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} [DecidableEq α] (h : s ⋖ t) : ∃ a ∈ t, t.erase a = s := by
  rcases Finset.ssubset_iff_exists_subset_erase.mp h with ⟨a, ha, hsub⟩
  use a
  apply Finset.subset.antisymm
  · exact hsub
  · rw [Finset.erase_subset_iff_of_mem.2 ha]
    exact Finset.ssubset_subset h
```
